# Generate a suite of diagnostic plots

<small>Source: [`R/plotDiagnostics.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/plotDiagnostics.R) · Help: `?plotDiagnosticSuite`</small>

This convenience wrapper returns residual-vs-fitted and spread-level plots
to help visually assess heteroscedastic patterns.

## Usage

```r
plotDiagnosticSuite(model, enhanced = FALSE)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   A fitted model of class `lm`.

`enhanced`
:   Logical, passed to [`plotResidualsFitted()`](plotResidualsFitted.md). `TRUE` returns
    what the deprecated `plotDiagnosticSuiteEnhanced()` returned.

## Value

A list with elements `residuals_fitted` and `spread_level`, each a
`ggplot` object.

## Examples

```r
data(mtcars)
m <- lm(mpg ~ wt + qsec, data = mtcars)
plots <- plotDiagnosticSuite(m)
plots$residuals_fitted
```
